source.value: Rippers Unmasked — Core Rulebook v1.1 (Volcano, ultimate)

summary.value: You channel the fury of the planet into a powerful wave of fire and magma.

system.description: You channel the fury of the planet into a powerful wave of fire and magma. Choose one option: you deal 50 fire damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 30 fire damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances and Immunities.
